headlines.description: — Dean Kremer pitched six impressive innings in his return from a quad injury, and the Baltimore Orioles avoided a sweep Wednesday with a 6-1 victory over the Chicago White Sox.
headlines.shortLinkText: Kremer sharp in his return as the Orioles avoid a sweep with a 6-1 win over the White Sox

headlines.description: — David Fry and Austin Hedges hit home runs, and the Cleveland Guardians defeated Texas 9-4 on Wednesday to snap the Rangers' six-game winning streak.
headlines.shortLinkText: Fry and Hedges homer to power Guardians to a 9-4 victory over Rangers in series finale

events.name: Detroit Tigers at New York Yankees

headlines.description: — The New York Yankees’ losing streak stretched to seven, their longest in three years, as Camilo Doval forced in the go-ahead run with a bases-loaded walk to Spencer Torkelson in a four-run 11th inning that gave the Detroit Tigers a 6-2 victory...
headlines.shortLinkText: Yankees' losing streak stretches to 7, longest since 2023, with 6-2, 11-inning defeat to Tigers

events.name: Washington Nationals at Boston Red Sox

headlines.description: — James Woods belted a three-run homer for his 22nd of the season, Andrés Chaparro and Nasim Nuñez each hit their first and the Washington Nationals beat the Boston Red Sox 10-2 on Wednesday afternoon at steamy Fenway Park to take the series.
headlines.shortLinkText: James Woods hits a 3-run homer as the Nationals beat the Red Sox 10-2 to take the series

events.name: San Diego Padres at Chicago Cubs

headlines.description: — Dansby Swanson hit three home runs, including a grand slam, Michael Conforto homered twice and the Chicago Cubs pounded the San Diego Padres 23-3 on Wednesday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Dansby Swanson has 3 homers and 8 RBIs as the Cubs pound the Padres 23-3

events.name: New York Mets at Toronto Blue Jays

headlines.description: — Sean Keys hit his first career home run, Myles Straw added a pinch-hit shot and the Toronto Blue Jays beat the New York Mets 9-3 in a Canada Day matinee Wednesday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Sean Keys hits 1st career home run as Blue Jays beat slumping Mets 9-3 in Canada Day matinee

headlines.description: — Trea Turner hit a three-run home run during a five-run second inning, Bryce Harper’s misjudged double scored two runs in the fourth, and the Philadelphia Phillies beat struggling Pittsburgh ace Paul Skenes and the Pirates 10-6 on Wednesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Phillies beat Paul Skenes and the Pirates 10-6 as Turner hits a 3-run homer

events.name: St. Louis Cardinals at Atlanta Braves

headlines.description: — Ozzie Albies homered and drove in two runs, and the Atlanta Braves held the St. Louis Cardinals to two hits in a 5-1 victory Wednesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Ozzie Albies powers the Braves past the Cardinals 5-1 as López and the bullpen allow 2 hits

events.name: Tampa Bay Rays at Kansas City Royals

headlines.description: — Junior Caminero homered in his sixth straight game to match the Tampa Bay record, hitting a two-run shot in the first first inning to help the Rays beat the Kansas City Royals 4-0 on Wednesday night for their seventh victory in a row.
headlines.shortLinkText: Junior Caminero homers in 6th straight game to lead Rays to 7th win in a row

headlines.description: — Garrett Mitchell tripled in the go-ahead run in the seventh inning to cap a four-hit night to help the NL Central Division-leading Milwaukee Brewers beat the Cincinnati Reds 4-2 on Wednesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Mitchell triples in the go-ahead run in the 7th in the Brewers' 4-2 win over the Reds

headlines.description: — Taj Bradley struck out 11 to tie his career high, Josh Bell, Kody Clemens and Luke Keaschall homered and the Minnesota Twins beat the Houston Astros 8-3 on Wednesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Taj Bradley fans 11 in Twins' 8-3 win over the Astros

headlines.description: — Mickey Moniak finished a single shy of the cycle, Hunter Goodman hit a two-run homer to cap a four-run fifth inning and the Colorado Rockies beat Miami 6-3 on Wednesday night to snap an eight-game losing streak against the Marlins.
headlines.shortLinkText: Moniak and Goodman power Rockies past Marlins 6-3 to stop 8-game skid against Miami

events.name: Los Angeles Dodgers at Athletics Athletics

headlines.description: — Shea Langeliers hit his 20th home run and the Athletics defeated the Los Angeles Dodgers 7-1 on Wednesday night to stop a four-game losing streak, their longest this season.
headlines.shortLinkText: Langeliers hits No. 20 and A's back Ginn with 3 HRs in 7-1 win over Dodgers that snaps 4-game skid

events.name: San Francisco Giants at Arizona Diamondbacks

headlines.description: — Trevor McDonald pitched six scoreless innings, Victor Bericoto hit a two-run homer and the San Francisco Giants beat the Arizona Diamondbacks 6-4 on Wednesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Trevor McDonald allows 1 hit over 6 scoreless innings as Giants finally beat Diamondbacks, 6-4
